notes.title: 🎮 Exciting News: Plane Accident Game Premiere! 🛩️
notes.content:
[b]Dear fellow investigators and aviation enthusiasts,[/b]

Get ready for an exhilarating new chapter in the Accident universe! We are thrilled to announce that the premiere of our much-anticipated game, "Plane Accident," is just around the corner!

✈️ Scheduled Release Dates:

[list]
[*] [b]Prologue: January 18, 2024 (Free to Play)[/b]
[*] [b]Early Access Version: February 22, 2024[/b]
[/list]

🔍 Step into the Shoes of an Investigator:
In "Plane Accident," you take on the role of an aviation investigator delving into the mysteries of plane crashes. Uncover the truth behind each incident, examine evidence, and experience the challenges of solving aviation puzzles.

📽️ Watch the Investigative Trailer:
Get a sneak peek into the intense world of investigation in "Plane Accident" by checking out our official trailer here. The skies await, and we can't wait for you to embark on this thrilling journey with us!

[previewyoutube=77Unku0h6zE;full][/previewyoutube]
👉 Wishlist Now:
Add "Plane Accident" to your Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682340/Plane_Accident/

Thank you for your unwavering support. We can't wait to see you don the investigator's hat and immerse yourself in the world of "Plane Accident."

Happy investigating! 🕵️‍♂️✨

notes.title: Dinosaur Investigator - Bundle Updated with Designer DLC!
notes.content:
Dear Players!

Our bundle Dinosaur Investigator with Dinosaur Fossil Hunter just got expanded with Designer DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/c9561967eefa7d4b36be86176fd0fca55dec344f.png[/img]

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jujck4k-jy8

With Designer DLC, you can paint life-sized dinosaur models of all species available in the game. Grim black T-Rex? Earthly brown triceratops? Or maybe you want go all out and create the most attention catching dinosaur possible? Nothing is impossible!

Designer DLC contains:
- 10 Dinosaur species to paint
- 10 poses for each Dinosaur species to arrange your display
- 2 gameplay modes:
-- Normal (which takes game progression into account)
-- Sandbox (which allows you to paint every Dino from start)
- 50+ textures for skin, scales etc...
- 30+ skin patterns and decals
- 20+ blood decals
- Full color palette
- 130+ texture sets with skins
- 20+ independent textures for free combination with skin textures
- 30+ additional decals for museum decoration in 2 color variants

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065550/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Designer_DLC/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/0b2aeab2e8113b232f80d6ee63f611a67e90bea3.png[/img]

That's not all!

Next month another DLC - Raptor will also be added to this bundle!

The Raptor DLC will include:
- new Dinosaur species: Utahraptor ostrommaysi
- new active dig sites on Dinosaur Canyon location
- 10 skeleton poses
- 252 unique bones

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217690/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Raptor_DLC/

notes.title: Steam Autumn Festival: Accident
notes.content:
Find out, what happened!

Become an investigative journalist who uses modern technology to recreate past road accidents. 

[list]
[*] Secure the site, help the victims and gather clues to find out, what has really happened before the calamity
[*] Use your skills to perform CPR and give first-aid to the victims in need
[*] Decide, who to help first and beat the clock before the victims die
[*] Analyze clues, make the puzzles complete and solve the mysteries to gain access to more complicated cases
[/list]  

Accident is a puzzle game packed with action and detective work. Besides pure fun, it also has a strong educational factor - you will learn, how to act in case of a road emergency and what to do, to secure yourself and those in need. If you like simulation games and you want to learn something new about first-aid response and preserving safety during road accidents, you definitely have to try out Accident!
